mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id, user_id_1, user_id_2, last_message_id, COALESCE(last_message_time, create_time) AS last_message_time, create_time, update_time FROM conversations WHERE (user_id_1 = #{userId} OR user_id_2 = #{userId}) ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_time, create_time) DESC, conversation_id DESC
